name: Tick Buffer
description: Customisable click leniency in physics ticks: orbs/rings, ground gamemodes (cube/ball/robot/spider) and a trajectory-lookahead assist for wave. Open the menu with F6 or from the pause menu.

ground-buffer.name: Ground buffer (cube, ball, robot, spider)
ground-buffer.description: Early: a click shortly before landing still jumps on landing. Late: a click shortly after walking off an edge still jumps.

wave-assist.name: Wave lookahead assist
wave-assist.description: Predicts the wave's path against hazard/solid hitboxes and corrects your input a few ticks early if you would otherwise hit something.

wave-lookahead.name: Wave lookahead (ticks)
wave-lookahead.description: How far ahead the wave planner simulates. Larger = more forgiving.

wave-hitbox.name: Wave hitbox size (units)
wave-hitbox.description: Square hitbox used by the planner (scaled by mini wave). Tune if predictions look off.

mark-as-test.name: Mark runs as test mode
mark-as-test.description: Prevents progress/completions from being saved while any assist is active (recommended, this is a practice assist).
